policy: A reviewed bugfix may add default-build code only in the files listed in default_code_allowed, only for this exact patch SHA256, and only when the caller supplies the review record whose SHA256 is listed. Every other hygiene rule still applies. Adding an entry is a CR decision: record the CR verdict file, its SHA256, the exact patch SHA256 and the exact changed-file scope.
